name: OUR ILLUSIONS
author: wokecat
description: Hold to the ceiling at 28% and continue holding until right when the percentage goes to 34%. Play through the following section as the ship until 40% where you can hold at the ceiling between the spikes. Go down at 50% and then fall to the floor at 51% to hit a yellow pad and then shortly after, hold into the top left corner of the ship portal at 52% and continue holding until you are above the level. Stay above the level until 90% where you can fall down onto an invisible moving platform. Free to the end from there.
